newsitem.title: GERMANY: KHD delivers Saudi plant without fines.
newsitem.headline: KHD delivers Saudi plant without fines.

text.p: Troubled German engineering group Kloeckner-Humboldt-Deutz AG said on Tuesday it has delivered a cement plant to the Saudi Cement Co (SCC) and that its Saudi customer has waived all late fees for the delayed project.

The waiver is part of a deal that Kloeckner struck with the Saudis earlier this year after it discovered that executives at its Wedag subsidiary had covered up losses linked to delayed construction of the Hofuf cement plant.
The plant, with a daily capacity of 3,500 tonnes, was originally scheduled to be completed in September 1995 but a new schedule was agreed after KHD nearly became insolvent.
